correctness.rationale: The 2d+binom(d,2) edge-Walsh parameters form an injective basis of the complete harmonic band. Any nonzero linear component forces at least six supported roots. For even functions with <=4 supports, at most two coordinate edges have nonzero vertex-sum parameters, so all other edges impose h_i+h_j=0. A connected nonbipartite K_d with at most two edges deleted forces h=0 for d>=5; K4 has one exceptional bipartite four-cycle precisely when the omitted edges are a perfect matching. It yields exactly 12 additional four-point supports besides the binom(d,2) coordinate squares. Exact integer Gram projection and exhaustive 12,950 <=4 erasure minors for d=4, plus witnesses for d<=10, were executed; analytic proof handles all d.
